REQ-AUTH-001.title: Users sign in with email and password
REQ-AUTH-001.description: Users authenticate by providing their email address (the canonical identifier) and a password. Usernames are NOT used as a login identifier — only the email.

API-AUTH-LOGIN.title: POST /auth/login
API-AUTH-LOGIN.description: Body: {email, password}. Returns a session token. The email field is required; usernames are not accepted.
